{{Quote|Only dead men fight fair.|Gault Rennow|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gault Rennow''', formerly known as '''Tyresius Lokai''' and using an alias '''Gellar Roing''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] he forged a romantic relationship with [[Hylo Visz]] and joined her [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|smuggling contingent]]. The two formed and executed a plan to profit by breaking the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], after which Lokai betrayed the woman he loved and absconded with her share of money, causing Hylo to disappear to escape her debts. Lokai led a successful career and lived in luxury style for decades, becoming well-known in galactic underworld. However, over time his debts piled up and resulted in multiple bounties in his head, making Lokai the target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. He managed to bribe one bounty hunter who was after him, but the other was more persistent, pursuing Lokai across [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Realizing he did not want to live while constantly looking over his shoulder, Lokai asked the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] to fake his death using a lifeless clone body of his and then joined the Hunter's crew, figuring he was safest from the bounty hunters in the company of one.

Changing his name to '''Gault Rennow''', the Devaronian traveled with the Hunter who became the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] for years, during which he came to regret abandoning Hylo and went to look for her. Using his old contacts from the days of the Blockade, he located Hylo in [[Belsavis prison]], where she spent almost three decades in stasis without aging a day. Her anger at him still fresh, Hylo initially wanted nothing to do with Gault, but over time slowly welcomed him back into her life. After the Grand Champion went missing during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], the crew looked for Hunter as long as they could, but eventually parted ways. Gault worked with several partners, eventually joining the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] escape artist [[Vette]]. During the [[war against Zakuul]] the two planned to rob [[Zakuul]]an [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] ''[[Gilded Star]]'', which caused Gault to ask Hylo for help once again. Hylo introduced him to the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that opposed the [[Eternal Empire]] and Gault recruited some of its leadership for the heist. Gault assembled his team on [[Vandin]] where his old associate [[Dretcher]] provided a disguise for [[Senya Tirall]] to get aboard the ship's bridge along with [[SCORPIO]]. From there, the droid opened the way to the ship's vault for Gault and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], while Vette disabled the vault's security mechanisms. Gault planted a missile warhead inside the vault, which upon detonation vaporized its entire content of precious metals than was then pumped into the tanker piloted by [[Lana Beniko]]. Gault, Vette and the Alliance Commander escaped the ship with Hylo's help and after everyone received their cut for the job, decided to stay and join the Alliance's cause. Gault later participated in the defense of the [[Alliance base]] during the [[Battle of Odessen]] and the [[Assault on Odessen]].

==Biography==
===Hylo Visz and the Hydian Way blockade===
{{Quote|Hylo was my old partner... more than that. That blockade run was the last thing we ever did together. Like I said, a lot of credits were involved.|Gault Rennow|<ref name="Exes and Ohs" />}}
[[File:Hylos_smugglers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Hylo and Gault with their associates]]
Tyresius Lokai was allegedly born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> He began his career as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and lived comfortably for many years under the radar of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Holonet"/> Lokai became a successful smuggler and [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] by the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. He joined [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent]] and forged a close relationship with Hylo, engaging in an intermittent but passionate love affair.<ref name="Exes and Ohs" /> In [[3660 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}} and [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] indicate that the Blockade of the Hydian Way is broken seven years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. As seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Treaty of Coruscant is ratified in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> Tyresius Lokai participated along with Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent in the [[Battle on the Hydian Way|battle]] that broke the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Then, Tyresius and Hylo Visz ultimately terminated their romantic relationship but remained friends and business partners in their professions as smugglers.<ref name="Exes and Ohs" />

===Career as Tyresius Lokai===
{{Quote|I didn't get to be the infamous Tyresius Lokai by placing sucker bets.|Gault Rennow|<ref name="TOR:WTS">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|Worth Their Salt}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tyresius_Lokai.png|thumb|right|200px|Tyresius Lokai]]
Tyresius Lokai ran multiple successful cons over more than three decades.<ref name="TOR:LS">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|Light Sleeper}}</ref> His talents for separating the wealthy and powerful with their credits and cargo made him one of the most infamous grifters in the galaxy.<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|companions|gault-rennow|Gault Rennow}}</ref> At some point he retired and spend a year on [[Makeb]]'s resorts, spending a hundred million credits belonging to Crown Prince of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], until the Prince noticed that his funds were missing.<ref name="Makeb">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref> Lokai amassed a small fortune, but with it came a considerable debt to his share of enemies,<ref name="Holonet"/> including the [[Corellian Exchange]] and and a half-dozen [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] families,<ref name="TOR:LS" /> including [[Karagga]]<ref name="Holonet"/> and [[Drooga]].<ref name="TOR:AFS">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|A Fresh Start}}</ref> With the bounties on his head came the paranoia, causing Lokai to constantly look over his shoulder for bounty hunters. Unable to enjoy his lifestyle and unwilling to abandon it, Lokai started to look for a way out.<ref name="Holonet" /> He contacted [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Slicer|identity slicer]] [[Dretcher]], who provided a genetically identical copy of Lokai to help him fake his own death. The Devaronian later claimed that Dretcher was trying to blackmail him and swindled several prominent residents of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in Dretcher's name, which resulted in a bounty on the Anomid's head. Dretcher was able to hide in a [[Cortosis]]-layered shipping container with life support for years, but every time he tried to leave under a new identity, Lokai would compromise it.<ref name="KotFE 13" />

===Track on Tatooine===
{{Quote|You're the toughest, most persistent bounty hunter I've ever met. I have only one thing left to say. Give me a job.|Gault Rennow, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:CASE" />}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates:1">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Lokai had lost his fortune but had still bounties on his head<ref name="TOR:CASE" /> from not only criminal syndicates and clan families, but Imperial and Republic security as well. Their combined value exceeded 2 million credits,<ref name="Holonet" /> making him worthy a target in the Mandalorian [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:TTT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Tatooine Target|D5-Mantis}}</ref> His bounty was assigned to [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Veeboo Lunx]]<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref> and [[Hunter (individual)|his rival]], the protegee of [[Crysta Markon]]. Another Great Hunt participant named [[Tarro Blood]] tipped off Lokai about the hunters, hoping to undermine his competitors and Lokai tried to run. However, [[Tyresius Lokai's starship|Lokai's starship]] was shot down over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TOR:TTT" /> by Veeboo Lunx<ref name="TOR:CV" /> and he had to make an emergency landing in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="TOR:CASE">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Catching A Slippery Eel|Tatooine}}</ref> The [[Hyperdrive regulator/Legends|hyperdrive regulator]] on his ship was broken,<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Barter with the Lady of Pain|Tatooine}}</ref> requiring Lokai to find another way off-world. The Devaronian walked across the desert to reach the city of [[Mos Ila]], where he hired a Human named [[Dindo (Human)|Dindo]] as a bodyguard. However, Veeboo Lunx soon caught up with them.<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> Luckily for him, Lokai had enough credits on his person to bribe the Rodian into abandoning the Hunt as well as eliminating the other Hunter.<ref name="TOR:CV" /> Lokai and Dindo then attempted to leave through [[Mos Ila Spaceport]] under alias "Gellar Roing".<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> While in the spaceport, he managed to leave an impression of a stellar businessman to a group of [[Arcona/Legends|Arconas]]<ref name="TOR:FA">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|Friendly Advice}}</ref> represented by [[Groona Biddle]],<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> who came to Tatooine to learn the secret of effective moisture farming.<ref name="TOR:FA" /> However, as a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] he remained highly recognizable and the second Hunter managed to corner and confront him in the [[Docking Bay 64]] before Lokai could leave the planet.<ref name="TOR:TtS" />

[[File:Gault_Rennow_1.png|thumb|left|250px|Lokai's lifeless body double]]
Lokai left his guards behind to stall the bounty hunter and escaped to the [[Lady of Pain's compound]], where he asked the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] for a new hyperdrive regulator. The [[Lady of Pain]] however was not interested in the goods he had - only in new experiences - and refused to make a deal with him. Lokai spent long enough negotiating with her that the bounty hunter managed to track him down, exposing him to the Lady as an infamous con artist with many marks on his head. The Lady ordered her guards to take Lokai away and to cut off his tongue, but in their search for weapons on his body the guards missed the [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]] hidden inside one of his horns. As soon as he was away from Lady and the bounty hunter, Lokai used his stun grenade to incapacitate the guards. He then stole the hyperdrive regulator that he required as well as a [[Swoop/Legends|Swoop Bike]] that he used to escape the compound.<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" /> Now having the means to repair his ship, Lokai returned to its landing site, but was followed by the bounty hunter. When Lokai's [[Bodyguard droid/Legends|bodyguard droid]] [[NK-33]] failed to stop his pursuer, the Devaronian played the last card he had up his sleeve. He revealed the existence of the body double aboard his ship and offered the bounty hunter to take it as a proof of his death, while also asking to join his pursuer's crew, reasoning that while otherwise bounty hunters would never stop coming after him, nobody would expect him to be in the companion of one. The Hunter agreed and Lokai shed his old identity, taking up the name Gault Rennow and joining the bounty hunter aboard his [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]].<ref name="TOR:CASE" />

===Becoming Gault Rennow===
{{Quote|I think that auction put to bed any lingering doubts that Tyresius is dead and gone.|Gault Rennow, embracing his new identity|<ref name="TOR:BF">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|Brighter Futures}}</ref>}}
[[File:Gault_Rennow_2.png|thumb|right|200px||Gault during his travels with the Hunter]]
Gault, as the man quickly took to call himself, fit in well with the bounty hunter crew alongside the slicer [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]].<ref name="TOR:CASE" /><ref name="TOR:PiC">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|Partners in Crime}}</ref> He offered the Hunter to make an extra profit for "killing" him by offering to collect other standing bounties on his head beyond the Great Hunt one. The interest for the body of "Tyresius" was so high, Gault eventually decided to auction it by proxy. An impressive gathering of underworld figures showed up, including three pirate crews, a dozen free traders, two [[Exchange]] bosses and half a dozen Hutts. The transaction went smoothly and Gault collected the maximum payoff for his own death, dealing the Hunter the promised cut.<ref name="TOR:AFS" /> He also picked up the contact with the Groona Biddle, planning to use Arcona's addiction to [[Salt/Legends|salt]] to get them hooked onto his product. As "Gellar Roing" he set up a front company [[Roing Industries]] to sell them salt-laced tablets that he claimed helped to maximize water retention in organic life-forms. Gault then contacted Groona and promised to send him first shipment free of charge, confident his clients will be hooked in no time.<ref name="TOR:WTS" />

The Hunter soon took down the last Great Hunt targets on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="TOR:KfaD">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Kingmaker for a Day|Alderaan}}</ref> and the [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']],<ref name="TOR:TMK">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Mandalorian Killer|the ''Aurora''}}</ref> becoming the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]<ref name="TOR:HtCH">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Hail the Conquering Hero|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> and earning an audience with [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], who offered the Hunter access to exclusive set of [[Blacklist]] bounties.<ref name="TOR:THoD">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Heart of Darkness|the ''Spirit of Vengeance''}}</ref> The Hunter claimed two of those bounties on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where the crew was joined by [[Mandalorian shock trooper|Mandalorian warrior]] [[Torian Cadera]],<ref name="TOR:HoG">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Honor or Glory|Taris}}</ref> and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where they picked up [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] scavenger [[Blizz]].<ref name="TOR:ICB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|In Cold Blood|Hoth}}</ref> However, a celebration of the Hunter's achievements with other Great Hunt champions turned into a [[Grand Champions massacre|bloodbath]], as Republic [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] put Hunter the top of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] Most Wanted list, while his men ambushed and killed the other former Champions. With the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] gunning for them, Gault suggested working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], an idea that Torian was firmly opposed to.<ref name="TOR:Notorious">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Notorious|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Before they could come to blows, the Hunter and the crew received a summons from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tormen]], who offered the Champion to work for him, promising revenge against Jun Seros and Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] for targeting them in return.<ref name="TOR:AFtC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Failure to Communicate|D5-Mantis}}</ref> The Hunter performed several tasks for Tormen,<ref name="TOR:ATP">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Thousand Pardons|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TSaBH">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|To Still a Bleeding Heart|Voss}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TTBL">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Thin Blue Line|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="TOR:Reckoning">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Reckoning|Corellia}}</ref> which eventually resulted in their status as the Most Wanted being dropped, as Janarus was killed by the Hunter.<ref name="TOR:NOwaB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Number One with a Bullet|the ''Founder''}}</ref>

[[File:Tyresius_Lokai_as_Gault_Rennow.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gault Rennow]]
The time spent with his new partner motivated Rennow to make amends for his past misdeeds&mdash;specifically, for having robbed and abandoned Hylo Visz.<ref name="Exes and Ohs" /> Around [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates:3">{{TOR_dates|3}}</ref> the Devaronian tracked down [[Quan]], another smuggler who had participated in the blockade run, and convinced him to reveal where Hylo had disappeared to, before shooting him to preserve his new identity. Quan revealed that Hylo Visz convinced another free trader [[Zale Barrows]] to hide her on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in the Republic's top secret [[Belsavis prison]], which existence was only recently uncovered. Gault discovered Visz's prison tomb on Belsavis and released her from the stasis in which she spend the past three decacdes. The Mirialan, who had not been conscious and had not aged since her internment, was initially confused but quickly became furious upon realizing that it was her old boyfriend who had freed her. She was prepared to kill her former partner, but ultimately decided not to attack. The two parted coldly, with Visz leaving Belsavis to return to the galaxy at large.<ref name="The One That Got Away">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Gault Rennow|The One That Got Away}}</ref> Her anger at Gault eventually subsided, and Hylo contacted him to establish a new relationship. She agreed to take him back, provided he could prove to her that she meant more to him than he meant to himself. The Devaronian eagerly accepted the offer, fully turning a new leaf in his life while Visz began a new chapter in her own.<ref name="TOR:PiC" />

===Raid on the '''Gilded Star'''===
{{Quote|I know a guy with a habit of showing up when someone's in need. He reached out with an offer we can't really refuse, much as I might want to. You should meet him.|Hylo Visz preparing Alliance Commander for a meeting with Gault|<ref name="KotFE 13" />}}
[[File:Gault_Rennow_4.png|thumb|right|200px|Gault Rennow arrives on Odessen]]
During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]<ref name="KotFE 13" /> in [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates:4.0">{{TOR_updates|4}}</ref> the Grand Champion went missing. The crew attempted to find the Hunter, even infiltrating the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] on [[Zakuul]], but unable to locate their target they eventually became broke and went separate ways. Gault had another falling out with Hylo and eventually teamed up with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]]. During the [[war against Zakuul]],<ref name="KotFE 13" /> in [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates:4.4">{{TOR_updates|4.4}}</ref> they came up with a plan to rob the ''[[Gilded Star]]'', a [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] to keep the valuables that was hiding deep in the atmosphere of [[Gas giant/Legends|Gas giant]] [[Vandin]]. The ship's vault was so strong, it could survive the rest of the ship being reduced to atoms, which have Gault and Vette an idea on how to empty it of valuables. Setting his plan in motion, Gault placed on order for a functional missile with the [[Brekken Gang]], asking the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] to deliver it to Vandin, while also sending to Vette sneak in and retrieve the missile's warhead. Gault also arranged for his old acquaintance [[Dretcher]]'s hiding place to be shipped to Vandin unannounced.<ref name="KotFE 13" />

[[File:Gault_Rennow_arrives_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gault proposes his plan to the Commander.]]
The warhead was intended to vaporize the vault's content of precious metal for easy transportation while Dretcher's job was to provide disguises, but Gault's scheme also required specific personnel to pull off the operation. For this part, he contacted Hylo, who by now was working with the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that opposed Zakuul and reluctantly invited him to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. On arrival, Gault played a hand of [[Holo-sabacc/Legends|Holo-Sabacc]] with Alliance members [[Theron Shan]], [[Koth Vortena]] and [[Lana Beniko]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and a former [[Minister of Sith Intelligence|Sith Intelligence Minister]]. During the game, Lana subtly tried to use the Force to read Gault's mind, but he projected dirty thoughts that concealed his hand and allowed him to win, prompting Beniko to accuse him of cheating. Hylo then introduced Gault to [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], whom she previously made aware of the Alliance's strained funds. Gault laid out his proposition, to which the Alliance Commander agreed and team of Alliance personnel which included Beniko, Shan, [[Senya Tirall]] and [[SCORPIO]] departed with them to Vandin.<ref name="KotFE 13" />

[[File:Gault_Rennow_on_Vandin.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gault Rennow approaches Dretcher on Vandin.]]
Arriving on the gas giant's [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] mining platform, Gault took the Alliance Commander to look for Dretcher's hiding container. Immediately recognizing Gault as Tyresius Lokai, Dretcher activated his battle droids and tried to rid of the Devaronian once and for all. However, Gault and the Commander easily destroyed the droids and though Dretcher's container boasted reinforced armor, Gault threatened to kill him by shaking him to death with a [[sonic amplifier]]. Dretecher had no choice but to let the Devaronian inside and agree to do his job in exchange for finally getting Tyresius off his back. Gault and the Commander then went to the meeting with the Brekken Gang and its Captain [[Kenrik Fost]]. Asking to inspect his missile, Gault announced his refusal to pay for it and, after the Niktos raised their arms, activated the warhead. The Nikto ran away trying to flee the blast radius, but Gault was unable to stop the countdown and it reached zero, only to reveal Vette inside the missile, who had already removed the warhead beforehand. Gault then assembled the entire team at their hideout and layed out his entire plan, assigning everybody's roles. Dretcher's part included forging the identity of [[High Justice]] [[Vaylin]] for her mother Senya Tirall, who provided a genetic match and required character knowledge and would take SCORPIO aboard as her "attache droid". They would access the bridge and lower security, allowing Vette, Gault and the Commander to get onboard and place the warhead inside the vault, while Shan and Beniko would pilot a tanker to siphon off the vaporized previous metals.<ref name="KotFE 13" />

[[File:Gault_Rennow_with_the_warhead.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gault brings the warhead inside the vault.]]
When the ''Gilded Star'' came up for its annual resupply, the team moved in positions. Dretcher's holographic disguise worked, allowing Senya to get aboard under identity of her daughter. From the bridge, SCORPIO opened the way to the vault for Gault and the Alliance Commander, while Vette used her sneaking skills to disable the vault's security mechanisms. Inside the vault, Gault planted the missile warhead, which upon detonation vaporized its entire content of precious metals, while leaving everything outside the vault safe and intact. The vault's entire content of precious metals was then pumped into the tanker piloted by Lana Beniko and Theron Shan, while SCORPIO and Senya soon joined them. Gault, Vette and the Alliance Commander encountered some difficulties when the only escape route left to them was to take the [[Skyhook]] down the way they came, but their path was blocked by real Vaylin, who arrived with an inspection. Determined to avoid confronting her, Gault suggested going outside on the ship's hull, where he received a call from Hylo Visz. His old partner was checking up on their progress and though Gault's companions had no context for the conversation, Hylo realized where Gault and the others were based on the noise and the wind. She piloted a small shuttle so that they could jump off from the ''Gilded Star'' directly and picked the three of them, while the rest of their team left aboard Beniko's tanker. Gault congratulated Hylo on the perfect timing and she gave him a kiss in return, the two becoming a couple once again.<ref name="KotFE 13" />

===Joining the Alliance===
{{Quote|I figure you'll be seeing me around. You've got a handy little outfit here. Besides, I wouldn't want Hylo to get lonely.|Gault Rennow, to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="KotFE 13" />}}
[[File:Gault_Rennow_and_Vette.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Gault and Vette joined the Alliance after the raid on the ''Gilded Star''.]]
Back on Odessen, Gault planned to divide everyone's share himself, but Hylo was having none of it given their previous experiences and payed him, Vette and Dretcher herself, while the major part of the profits went to fund the Alliance's operations. Having a small celebration alongside their new partners, Vette announced her intention to stay and join the Alliance's cause, while Gault did the same, giving him an opportunity to spend more time with Hylo.<ref name="KotFE 13" /> They both later participated alongside Gault's old associate [[Torian Cadera]] in the [[Battle of Odessen]] in which the Alliance managed to dethrone Emperor [[Arcann]], only for his sister Vaylin to claim the [[Eternal Throne]] instead.<ref name="KotFE 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref>

Later, following the [[Invasion of Voss]] in 3630 BBY<ref name="TOR_updates:5.0">{{TOR_updates|5}}</ref> rumors spread that the Commander was [[Ambush on Dromund Kaas|killed]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and former Republic Supreme Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh]] arrived in an attempt to take over the Alliance. Gault's face showed surprise when the Commander appeared alive and well to confront Saresh, though he later claimed he was never fooled by her for a moment; he also asked the Commander to deny knowing him if anyone contacted the Commander regarding an life insurance policy paid in their name.<ref name="KotET 2">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref> When Vaylin launched an [[Assault on Odessen]], Gault joined in the defense of the Alliance base, making a stand against Zakuulan forces alongside [[Bowdaar]]. During the battle the Commander was able to land a killing blow on Vaylin,<ref name="KotET 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref> but with the Eternal Throne empty the [[GEMINI]] captains have gone rogue, bombarding the capital worlds of [[Bombardment of Coruscant|Coruscant]], [[Bombardment of Dromund Kaas|Dromund Kaas]] and Zakuul into rubble. To claim the Eternal Throne and stop the carnage, the Alliance forces departed for Zakuul, Gault and Hylo among them. There, the Commander [[Battle of Zakuul|claimed]] the Eternal Throne and proclaimed the age of the [[Eternal Alliance]],<ref name="KotET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref> which Hylo and Gault continued to be a part of.<ref name="TOR:TGoMS">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|The Gangs of Mek-Sha|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates:6">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War|renewed war]] between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, Hylo and Gault joined the Alliance Commander during a [[Mission to Mek-Sha|mission]] on [[Mek-Sha]] to secure refueling of [[Twenty-Ninth Fleet|a Republic fleet]] in anticipation of an [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|Imperial attack]] on a [[Meridian Complex|Corellian shipyard]]. Hylo and Gault helped the Commander to familiarize with the different gangs of Mek-Sha and convince the criminal to sell fuel to the Republic. <ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You win some, you lose some. You just lost some.|Gault Rennow|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Gault_Rennow_in_armor.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Gault Rennow]]
Tyresius Lokai was a suave criminal, who lived in luxury by suckering gullible people out of their money. The Devaronian claimed he was born lucky, noting that he always came out alright no matter how bad the situation he got himself into was. Early in his career, he was willing to backstab everyone for the money, including the woman he loved. Over time, he regretted that decision and became wiser, for example he never attempted to con the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] knowing the Hunter was too tough and persistent for him to handle. As the number of bounties on his head increased, Lokai took increasingly high precautions about his life,<ref name="TOR" /> obtaining both droid<ref name="TOR:CASE" /> and organic bodyguards,<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> keeping a stun grenade in his fake horn<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" /> and eventually making an entire duplicate of himself.<ref name="TOR:CASE" /> According to his former bodyguard [[Dindo (Human)|Dindo]], Lokai able to negotiate better than the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]]<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> and the Devaronian was even able to prevent Force-sensitives from reading his thought by imagining really gross and disgusting things.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Gault_Rennow_5.png|thumb|right|250px|Gault and his longtime partner Hylo Visz]]
Gault had a decades long on-and-off-again relationship with [[Hylo Visz]], thanks to both his natural longevity and the decades that Hylo spend in stasis on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. They broke up and got back together multiple times, occasionally working jobs even between the times they were a couple. Gault ruined Hylo's life big time in the aftermath of the Hydian blockade, robbing the Mirialan of her rewards and leaving her with no money to repay the Hutts, which caused her to hide on Belsavis for decades. He eventually came to regret it and sought her out to release her, after which their relationship continued to have its ups and downs.<ref name="TOR" /> For example, during her days in the [[Eternal Alliance]] Hylo went from willing to shoot the Devaronian to barely tolerating his presence to embracing him in a kiss after spending some more time together.<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gault Rennow appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a companion for the Bounty Hunter class,<ref name="TOR:CASE" /> voiced by [[Daran Norris]].<ref name="TOR" /> After the completion of '''"Chapter XIII: Profit and Plunder"''' of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion he becomes a companion for all classes.<ref name="KotFE 13" />

During his companion mission, player can allow Gault to swindle [[Groona Biddle]] and get him addicted to drugs for Dark Side points, or advise Groona not to deal with him for Light Side points and Gault's disapproval.<ref name="TOR:WTS" /> During ''Fallen Empire'' '''"Chapter XIII: Profit and Plunder"''' Gault will offer to put the excess money into an investment scheme, the player can agree for Dark Side points or either keep the money in the Alliance or share it with people who suffered under Zakuul for Light Side points.<ref name="KotFE 13" /> During ''Fallen Empire'' '''Chapter XVI: The Battle of Odessen''', player has to assign roles for Torian Cadera, Gault, and Vette, ordering one to stay behind on [[Odessen]], another to sabotage the weapons on the [[Eternal Flagship]], and the third to sabotage the Eternal Flagship's shields. In any choice, the ship is disabled successfully and the ground forces never land on Odessen, with the only difference being in dialogue.<ref name="KotFE 16" />
